tokens.name: highland
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour. Logo tile, header bars, buttons, uniforms, van livery. Print and the logo always use #173d36; the dark value only lifts it off a dark screen.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Accent: the llama's woven neck band, small marks, bullets, one highlight per layout. Never text or thin lines on light surfaces (2.1:1). On highland it passes for graphics and large text (5.4:1).

tokens.name: saffron-ink
tokens.usage: Saffron for text: the tagline and small accent labels on surface-page and surface-card (5.4:1 light, 8.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page and paper background. A cool off-white with a green lean, never cream.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, the header bar, documents.

tokens.name: surface-sage
tokens.usage: Quiet bands and panels, table stripes, card footers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on every surface (13:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, the logo descriptor. 5.3:1 or better on page, card and sage.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and the llama on highland.

tokens.name: on-brand-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on highland, the white logo's COMMERCIAL line (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, input borders.

tokens.name: code-red
tokens.usage: Colour-coded cleaning only: toilets, urinals, washroom floors. Shown as a swatch with its word, never as the only signal.

tokens.name: code-blue
tokens.usage: Colour-coded cleaning only: general areas (offices, halls, corridors).

tokens.name: code-green
tokens.usage: Colour-coded cleaning only: kitchens, food and bar areas.

tokens.name: code-yellow
tokens.usage: Colour-coded cleaning only: clinical areas and washroom sinks.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Ad and flyer headlines. Sentence case, one per piece.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: Italic, in saffron-ink (or saffron on highland). The tagline only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every site gets a written specification before we start.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Specifications, job references, schedules, timestamps.

tokens.usage: Icon gaps.

tokens.usage: Default gap and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between major blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero and poster margins.

tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, swatches.

tokens.usage: Cards and panels.
